name: Cash Withdrawal 1
definition: Withdrawal of an amount of money defined in cash notes and or cash coins.

AmendmentIndicator.name: Amendment Indicator
AmendmentIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the denominations in the original cash withdrawal request have been amended.||Usage: where this element is not used the denominations match the original cash withdrawal request or no denominations were included in the original cash withdrawal request.

NoteDetails.name: Note Details
NoteDetails.definition: Specifies the details of the requested withdrawal in notes.

CoinDetails.name: Coin Details
CoinDetails.definition: Specifies the details of the requested withdrawal in coins.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Total amount of all notes and coins being withdrawn.
